containers.name: experiment
command:
mkdir -p /results/swm-auxiliary-train-v2-work
tar xzf /source/app.tar.gz -C /results/swm-auxiliary-train-v2-work
cd /results/swm-auxiliary-train-v2-work
export PYTHONPATH=/results/swm-auxiliary-train-v2-work:/results/swm-auxiliary-train-v2-work/deps:/results/work/upstream
export DREAMER_SOURCE=/results/work/upstream
/results/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_supervision.py tests/test_microservice.py tests/test_mechanisms.py tests/test_latent_probe.py tests/test_regularized_head.py
/results/venv/bin/python -c 'from pathlib import Path; import json,hashlib; p=Path('"'"'/results/micro-auxiliary-v1/development/identity-21.json'"'"'); identity={'"'"'seed'"'"': 21, '"'"'steps'"'"': 100000, '"'"'compositional'"'"': True, '"'"'mechanism_supervision'"'"': True, '"'"'calibration_sha256'"'"': '"'"'9121c40cab47960f8f41ea57b605fa20a41509b8c457abe60132ef07207f077b'"'"'}; assert hashlib.sha256(Path('"'"'/results/micro-mechanisms-v1/calibration.jsonl'"'"').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity['"'"'calibration_sha256'"'"']; assert not p.exists(); p.write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))'
/results/venv/bin/python -m microservice.train --data /results/micro-mechanisms-v1/calibration.jsonl --out /results/micro-auxiliary-v1/development --seed 21 --steps 100000 --compositional --mechanism-supervision --resume
